findings.evidence: The declaration at lines 43–47 is `Kˣ →* ...`; Mathlib consistently defines number-field units as `(𝓞 K)ˣ` (for example `Mathlib/NumberTheory/NumberField/Units/Basic.lean:16` and `Units.complexEmbedding` at lines 106–109).
findings.fix: Assume `[NumberField K]`, define the map on `(𝓞 K)ˣ` via its inclusion into `Kˣ`, and define/prove the corresponding subgroup and kernel for totally positive integer units (or rename this as a field-element sign map and remove all narrow-class/unit-signature claims).
findings.issue: `unitSignature` has domain `Kˣ`, i.e. every nonzero field element, whereas the narrow-class signature map has domain `(𝓞 K)ˣ`; consequently the claim that its unrealized signs measure `Cl⁺(K) → Cl(K)` is false for this definition.

summary: The map uses the field’s full multiplicative group, not the arithmetic unit group required for the narrow class group, so it does not formalize the stated unit signature map.
